observations: Five round-headed figures are outlined in thick white lines against stacked horizontal bands of orange, magenta, purple, and yellow-green; the white outlines give each figure a sticker-like separation from the ground.
The central figure's mouth opens wide showing a row of teeth; the figure to its left displays a similar toothed grin; both faces carry dense black scribbled fill over bright color.
A bone shape floats in the upper left near the leftmost figure; loose black line-work layers over the color bands throughout, functioning as both background texture and foreground detail.
reading: Several round-headed figures crowd the space, their white outlines pressing them forward against a loud field of color bands. Two open mouths—one a wide toothed grin, one a dark open gap—give the scene a range that reads somewhere between comic and unsettled. The bone in the upper left adds an odd prop without resolving what the gathering means. The scribbled fill keeps every form restless rather than settled.
